book.name: Taalie
book.title: Ala xa Taalie Ala xa Taalie

content.text: Booretare a waxɔnfe gbansan nan fenma,
a yo marasi birin ma.
Xaxilitare mu wama xaxili fanyi xɔn,
a wama a yɛtɛ xa maɲɔxunyi nan tun masenfe.
Mixi ɲaaxie yoma mixie ma,
e yoma e ma han e sa yaagi.
Adama xa wɔyɛnyi tilin alɔ baa,
a lɔnni raminima naxan luxi alɔ dulonyi ye fanyi.
Nɔndi fife mixi ɲaaxi ma, a mu fan.
A mu lanma tinxintɔɛ xa tɔɔɲɛgɛ.
Lɔnnitare sɔnxɔɛ xɔrɛ isɔxɔma,
a bɔnbɔɛ sɔtɔma a dɛ saabui ra.
Xaxilitare dɛ a xun nakanama nɛ,
a nɛnyi findixi gantanyi nan na a nii bɛ.
Naafixi xa masenyi luxi nɛ alɔ donse ɲɔxunmɛ,
naxan goroma mixi furi kui.
Tunnaxɔnɛ nun kasarɛ raba,
nee nga keren, e baba keren.
Alatala findixi kantari sɛnbɛma nan na,
tinxintɔɛ luma naxan niini bun ma.
Naafuli findixi banna xa kantari nan na,
a ɲɔxɔ a ma tɛtɛ na a ra
naxan mu nɔma kanade.
Gbaloe na yɛtɛ igboɲa xanbi ra,
kɔnɔ nɔrɛ na yɛtɛ magore fɔxɔ ra.
Mixi naxan yaabi fima beenu a xa mixi xui ramɛ,
a daxuɲa masenma nɛ, a a yɛtɛ rayaagi.
Xaxili limaniyaxi mixi malima nɛ a xa fure kui,
kɔnɔ limaniya baxi naxan yi,
na mu kelima sɔnɔn.
Lɔnnila katama se kolonde,
a a tuli matima masenyi fanyi ra.
Kira rabixi mixi bɛ naxan ki tima,
mangɛe yati tofe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ na kanyi bɛ.
Mixi naxan singe a yɛtɛ xun mafalama fe kui,
a luma nɛ alɔ nɔndi na a tan nan bɛ,
kɔnɔ a kalamuti maxɔrinyi xɔrɔxɔɛ tima nɛ a ma.
Fe lufe Ala ma a sɔnxɔɛ ɲɔnma nɛ,
a gere ɲɔn sɛnbɛmae tagi.
Mixi konbixi xa bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ luma nɛ alɔ taa makantaxi.
Na sɔnxɔɛ mɔɔli xɔrɔxɔ dangife geeli kondonyi ra.
Adama xa masenyi nɔma a baloe fide a ma,
a hayi fanma nɛ a xa wɔyɛnyi saabui ra.
Faxɛ nun simaya fatanma mixi xa wɔyɛnyi nan na.
Wɔyɛnla a sare sɔtɔma nɛ.
Ginɛ sɔtɔfe findixi hɛɛri nan na,
naxan fatanxi Alatala ra.
Setare mayandi tima,
kɔnɔ se kanyi a yaabima a xɔrɔxɔɛ nan na.
Xa mixi booree wuya, na nɔma findide tɔɔrɛ ra a bɛ,
kɔnɔ boore nde na na naxan fan a ngaxakerenyi bɛ.
